scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!process.env.npm_config_user_agent || !process.env.npm_config_user_agent.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead: https://pnpm.io'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.engine:test: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); const exe = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'rust_video_engine\\rust_video_engine.exe' : './rust_video_engine/target/release/rust_video_engine'; cp.execSync(exe + ' --test', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
scripts.engine:serve: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'); const exe = process.platform === 'win32' ? 'rust_video_engine\\rust_video_engine.exe' : './rust_video_engine/target/release/rust_video_engine'; cp.execSync(exe + ' --serve', {stdio: 'inherit'});"
